summary: The terminal UI automatically remembers up to 50 device-local content destinations across spaces with stable group and tab identities.

schema.detail: No database schema change; device-local workspace format 3 adds bounded navigation history and still reads formats 1 and 2.

compatibility.detail: Existing keyboard shortcuts are unchanged. Workspace formats 1 and 2 load with fresh device-local identities; format 3 history receives identity migration when needed. History follows stable tabs moved between groups, including when their original group is removed, without replacing earlier content destinations. Older TUI versions cannot read format 3: running an older TUI after this version discards the saved place history and workspace layout on its next save.

recovery.detail: Use this version or newer to read and preserve the saved workspace. Downgrades are unsupported; roll forward to the new version rather than running an older TUI. If an older version has already saved over the workspace, rolling forward cannot recover the discarded history or layout.
